title: [CQ-C09] Documentation replacement recipe
description:

Deliverable: Documentation replacement recipe. This is task C09 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

implementationPlan.description:
Implement docsLiteralReplace.ts, pure plus bounded read-only Git, as the single C08 recipe kind 'docs-literal-replace', version 1. Error handling: every function returns a typed refusal reason and never throws. Git, IO, timeout and decode failures all map to an unavailable reason.
(a) validateDefinition(def): allowedPaths is a non-empty list of normalized repo-relative prefixes (normalizeAffectedFile). requiredChecks is non-empty, validated through validateExecutionContract({requiredChecks}).
(b) validateInputs(inputs, def): exact keys {path, originalSha256, oldText, newText}. path is normalized, *.md, not under .moe/, and equal to or under an allowedPaths prefix. originalSha256 is 64 lowercase hex. oldText is 1-2000 chars, newText 0-2000 chars, neither contains NUL, and newText !== oldText.
(c) inputsDigest: sha256 of canonical JSON [kind, version, path, originalSha256, oldText, newText].
(d) assessSource(projectRoot, commit, inputs): REUSE readRepositorySource with one read query, raising maxFileBytes within validateSourceRequest's bounds. Require status 'served', mode 100644 and sha256(Buffer.from(content,'utf8')) === originalSha256. The decoder is fatal UTF-8 with the BOM kept, so the round trip is byte-exact. Count occurrences with indexOf(old, i+1) so overlapping repeats count. Return {ok, commit, oid, expectedSha256}.
(e) instantiate(inputs, def, assessment): a deterministic ordinary plan. It is one step whose description JSON-quotes oldText and newText and states the expected post-patch sha256 and 'change nothing else'. It has affectedFiles [path] and an executionContract carrying intendedBehavior, acceptanceCriteria, approvedScope, sourceAssumptions (commit, oid, sha256), checkRefs and requiredChecks from the definition. It must fit MAX_STEP_DESCRIPTION_CHARS; refuse rather than truncate.
(f) assessPostpatch(projectRoot, {baseCommit, postCommit}, inputs, expectedSha256): run openProjectGit and diff-tree -r -z --no-renames --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --raw base post with a bounded maxBuffer. Excluding only the task's own board path .moe/tasks/<taskId>.json, the changed set must be exactly [path]. Then read path at post through readRepositorySource and require sha256 === expectedSha256. No writes, no shell, no filesystem fallback.
implementationPlan.note:
docsLiteralReplace.ts is the C08 RecipeKind 'docs-literal-replace' and self-registers via recipeKinds.set.
- validateDefinition: params is exactly {allowedPaths}, 1-16 canonical prefixes, none under .moe (case-insensitive).
- validateInputs: exact string keys, a canonical path with no control characters, 64 lowercase hex, texts of 1-2000 / 0-2000 chars, no NUL or lone surrogates, new !== old. Then *.md, not .moe, under a prefix by whole segments; otherwise path-not-allowed.
- assessSource: readRepositorySource at default limits, served plus 100644, sha over the re-encoded committed bytes, indexOf(old, offset+1) uniqueness. It also refuses source-unavailable when the patched bytes would exceed the 64 KiB read cap (new test row), so the post-patch check can always read them.
- instantiate: one step that JSON-quotes both texts and states the expected sha, 'change nothing else', error handling via moe.report_blocked, and the test commands. The contract has no requiredChecks; plan-too-large is refused instead of truncated.

Focused run in the Linux snapshot: all 44 DoD1/DoD2 cases pass. The DoD3 rows fail as expected (assessPostpatch comes in step 3).

The Write tool had emitted literal U+2028/2029/FEFF characters; they are now \u escapes and both files are ASCII-only.

amendments.description:
Implement docsLiteralReplace.ts as the C08 RecipeKind 'docs-literal-replace'. It is one module, and it self-registers at the bottom with recipeKinds.set(docsLiteralReplace.name, docsLiteralReplace).

Error handling: every hook returns a typed refusal reason and never throws. Git, IO, timeout and decode failures map to the unavailable reasons.

(a) validateDefinition(def):
- def.params is exactly {allowedPaths}: a non-empty list of at most 16 normalized repo-relative prefixes (normalizeAffectedFile(p) === p), none under .moe.
- requiredChecks presence and shape are the framework's job (recipe-definitions-invalid). Do not duplicate them.

(b) validateInputs(inputs, def):
- Exact keys {path, originalSha256, oldText, newText}, all strings.
- path is normalized, ends in .md, is not under .moe/, and is equal to or under an allowedPaths prefix. Compare whole segments: 'docs' covers 'docs/a.md', not 'docsx/a.md'.
- originalSha256 is 64 lowercase hex.
- oldText is 1-2000 chars and newText 0-2000 chars. Neither contains NUL, and newText !== oldText.

(c) assessSource(projectRoot, commit, inputs, def):
- REUSE readRepositorySource(projectRoot, commit, [{id:'doc', purpose:'source', op:'read', path}]), in try/catch, at its default limits.
- Require status 'served' and mode '100644'. A symlink, submodule, missing, refused, truncated or omitted item gives docs-replace-source-unavailable.
- Require sha256(Buffer.from(content,'utf8')) === originalSha256. The provider decodes fatal UTF-8 with the BOM kept, so the round trip is byte-exact.
- Count occurrences with indexOf(oldText, i + 1), so overlapping repeats count.
- Return {ok:true, assessment:{oid, offset, expectedSha256}}. expectedSha256 is the sha256 of the content with that single occurrence replaced.

(d) instantiate(inputs, def, assessment, commit): deterministic, with no IO.
- One step: replace the single literal in <path>.
  - JSON-quote oldText and newText.
  - State the expected post-patch sha256, and 'change nothing else, in this file or any other'.
  - Include error handling: if the file no longer matches, stop and call moe.report_blocked rather than edit.
  - Then run each required test check (the definition's commands).
  - affectedFiles [path].
- executionContract:
  - intendedBehavior;
  - acceptanceCriteria: the post-patch sha256, and no other path changed;
  - approvedScope [path];
  - sourceAssumptions: commit, oid, originalSha256 and offset;
  - checkRefs: the definition's commands;
  - never requiredChecks, which C08 supplies.
- If the description would exceed MAX_STEP_DESCRIPTION_CHARS (util/planSize.ts), refuse with docs-replace-plan-too-large rather than truncate.

Make the DoD1 and DoD2 cases green. Do not edit recipe.ts, submitPlan.ts, taskStore.ts or schema.ts.

implementationPlan.note:
assessPostpatch(projectRoot, {taskId, instance, definition, postCommit}) never throws. Checks run cheap first:
1. The kind, id, version and recipeDefinitionDigest must match the instance; otherwise recipe-mismatch.
2. recipeInputsDigest plus validateInputs; otherwise inputs-changed.
3. Hex checks on postCommit and instance.commit.
4. openProjectGit `diff-tree -r -z --raw --no-renames --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --ignore-submodules=none <base>^{commit} <post>^{commit}` with a 1 MiB maxBuffer, parsed strictly (header regex plus non-empty path pairs). Only .moe/tasks/<taskId>.json is ignored; any other changed path is extra-edits with a detail listing the paths. If the target path is absent, patch-missing.
5. Re-assess the original at instance.commit (a source-unavailable refusal maps to unavailable, any other refusal to mismatch), then read the post bytes via readRepositorySource. served + 100644 + sha equal to the expected → ok, else postpatch-mismatch; Git or read failures → postpatch-unavailable.

The comment documents the exact-commit, interleaved-peers-fail-closed rule. No post-patch call site was wired (activation is out of scope), and recipe.ts, submitPlan.ts, taskStore.ts and schema.ts are untouched.

amendments.description:
Implement docsLiteralReplace.assessPostpatch(projectRoot, {taskId, instance, definition, postCommit}), with the same error handling: it never throws.

C08 lands no post-patch call site, by agreement (msg-c7ac9a51 and C08's planningNotes). Wiring it into complete_task or the delivery policy is activation (C11 or a follow-up). Do NOT edit those files or C08's.

Order, cheap first:
1. The definition's id, kind, version and recipeDefinitionDigest(definition) must equal the instance's recipeId, kind, recipeVersion and definitionDigest. Otherwise: docs-replace-recipe-mismatch.
2. recipeInputsDigest(definition, instance.inputs) === instance.inputsDigest, and validateInputs passes. Otherwise: docs-replace-inputs-changed.
3. postCommit is 40 or 64 lowercase hex.
4. Bounded, read-only Git through openProjectGit (util/cachedPlanPaths.ts): `diff-tree -r -z --no-renames --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --raw <instance.commit> <postCommit>`, with a bounded maxBuffer.
   - Parse strictly; any parse failure is unavailable.
   - Ignore only .moe/tasks/<taskId>.json.
   - Any other path gives docs-replace-extra-edits.
   - No entry for the path gives docs-replace-patch-missing.
5. Re-read the path at instance.commit and at postCommit through readRepositorySource.
   - The original must still hash to originalSha256.
   - The post bytes must equal the original with the single occurrence replaced, and the mode must stay 100644. Otherwise: docs-replace-postpatch-mismatch.

Git or read failures give docs-replace-postpatch-unavailable.

Document in one comment that postCommit must contain only this task's changes on top of instance.commit, so interleaved peer commits fail closed as extra edits.

Make the DoD3 cases green, within 400 net lines over the 2 files.

CHECKED, no action needed:
- BOM/CRLF are byte-exact (tested). NUL in either text gives inputs-invalid; a NUL in the file is a binary refusal.
- Overlapping repeats are counted. A newText containing oldText is fine, since post-patch compares exact bytes, not uniqueness.
- Paths: case-sensitive prefix match; .moe is refused case-insensitively. Traversal, backslash and control characters are inputs-invalid. Symlinks, symlink ancestors and gitlinks are refused by the provider; 100755 is refused by the mode check.
- A doc changed after binding: the exact instance.commit→postCommit diff turns it into mismatch or extra-edits. An edit to .moe/recipes.json is extra-edits (tested).
- Concurrent instantiation: the kind is stateless; C08/submit_plan serialize the row write.
- Git timeout or overflow (2s openProjectGit budget, 1 MiB diff cap, 3s provider budget) gives an unavailable reason, never a throw.
- No .moe edits and no Git writes (only diff-tree and provider reads with --no-optional-locks). Legacy tasks are untouched: no production module imports docsLiteralReplace.ts, so the kind registers only when activation (C11/final) imports it.

THEORETICAL, noted for QA:
- A path over ~780 chars overflows a 1000-char contract item, so submit_plan refuses it as recipe-plan-refused:INVALID_INPUT (fail-closed).
- A forbidden-pattern string inside oldText/newText falls back as CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION.
- assessPostpatch trusts the caller's taskId for the one ignored board path.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: I proposed the split to the C08 architect (architect-e4b7eee0, msg-af90dfdb) and had no reply when this plan was submitted. C08 owns the definition storage and protection, the internal-identity instantiation through submit_plan validation (CONTROL, SPEED and TURBO), and the fallback. C09 owns one kind, in new files. I rejected a hand-rolled blob reader: readRepositorySource (C02) already does bounded, committed-only, UTF-8-strict reads that refuse symlinks and submodules. I also rejected worktree reads, because the shared checkout is dirty. And I rejected a complete_task file-list check, because TOOL-tier attribution can land files the worker never reported. The post-patch check therefore diffs commits.

completionSummary:
CQ-C09 docs-literal-replace recipe kind. 2 new files, 330 lines (cap 400): docsLiteralReplace.ts 161, docsLiteralReplace.test.ts 167 (67 tests on real temp Git repos). No C08, submitPlan, taskStore or schema edits.

Behaviour:
- C08 RecipeKind 'docs-literal-replace', self-registered in recipeKinds.
- validateDefinition: params is exactly {allowedPaths}, 1-16 canonical prefixes, none under .moe. requiredChecks stay C08's job.
- validateInputs: exact string keys {path, originalSha256, oldText, newText}; canonical path, no control chars; 64 lowercase hex; old 1-2000 / new 0-2000 chars; no NUL or lone surrogates; new !== old. Then *.md, not .moe, under a prefix by whole segments.
- assessSource: committed bytes via readRepositorySource; served + 100644; sha of the re-encoded bytes (BOM/CRLF exact); exactly one occurrence, overlaps counted. Patched bytes must fit 64 KiB.
- instantiate: one step that JSON-quotes both texts and states the expected sha, 'change nothing else', the report_blocked error handling and the test commands. affectedFiles [path]; contract approvedScope [path], checkRefs = commands, no requiredChecks. plan-too-large instead of truncation.
- assessPostpatch: recipe-mismatch, then inputs-changed, then exact diff-tree from instance.commit to postCommit. Only .moe/tasks/<taskId>.json is ignored; otherwise extra-edits (with detail) or patch-missing. Then a byte-exact post check (mismatch); failures give unavailable. Never throws.
